_about: Public-domain Peter Bulkeley (1583-1659), first minister of Concord, Massachusetts, for the Word Hoard: The Gospel-Covenant, or the Covenant of Grace Opened (London, 1651), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 51 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
